corrections.decision: MIPI CSI has no numeric register bank in chapter 10; no CSI registers or instances invented.
corrections.evidence: 10.1.1-10.1.3; address-map chapter 6 has no CSI instance address.

corrections.decision: V2D MMU, AFBC and interrupt capabilities have no separate numeric control/status tables in this chapter. Do not import K1 top/FBC/MMU offsets into the K3 V2 bank.
corrections.evidence: 10.3.2 and 10.3.6; 07_interrupts.md:107 supplies APLIC input 86, not V2D interrupt-register definitions.

corrections.decision: GPU has features but no numeric registers in chapter 10; the address-map base alone cannot define a register bank.
Functional text mentions only layers 0 and 1, but the numeric V2 bank contains layers 0 through 3. Use four layers, stride 0x54.
corrections.evidence: 10_image.md:1112-1979, V2D_V2_REG_43 through V2D_V2_REG_126; K3 V1.13 PDF pp.229-246.

corrections.decision: Functional Output_format is called 3-bit, but the numeric R_OUT_FORMAT field is bits 3:0. Retain the numeric four-bit field without extrapolating enum values.
K3 RDMA burst length is eight bits at 23:16, unlike the related K1 C field at 3:1. Do not copy the K1 control bit layout.
Keep K3 V2 offsets relative to 0xC0100000, without the K1 core offset 0x100. K1 top, encoder, decoder and MMU registers are not K3 supplements.
Trigger and configuration share one word; expose read/direct-write views without RMW. Source fields remain RW facts; this API restriction does not claim W1C.
corrections.evidence: 10_image.md:658-665; https://github.com/spacemit-com/linux-6.6/blob/31c449aeaad8c7759bc983ca0e26946e5b6746dc/drivers/soc/spacemit/v2d/v2d_hw.c#L833-L858 uses a complete trigger/configuration write for the related K1 core.

corrections.decision: Preserve DAMC spelling for the two clear fields; do not silently rename them DMAC.
corrections.evidence: 10_image.md:2007-2008; K3 V1.13 PDF p.247; https://github.com/spacemit-com/linux-6.6/blob/31c449aeaad8c7759bc983ca0e26946e5b6746dc/drivers/soc/spacemit/v2d/v2d_reg.h#L272-L292 uses the same damc spelling.

corrections.decision: DMA clear controls and configuration share one word; expose read/direct-write views without RMW. Clear polarity and self-clearing behavior are unspecified. Do not infer W1C from CLR names or grant modify.
corrections.evidence: 10_image.md:2005-2019 declares RW but descriptions contain no side-effect definition; https://github.com/spacemit-com/linux-6.6/blob/31c449aeaad8c7759bc983ca0e26946e5b6746dc/drivers/soc/spacemit/v2d/v2d_hw.c#L819-L830 uses a complete DMA configuration write.

corrections.decision: Palette contains exactly 256 32-bit entries; index 255 is offset 0x604, not an unbounded formula.
corrections.evidence: V2D_V2_REG_130-385; 10_image.md:2021-4066; https://github.com/spacemit-com/linux-6.6/blob/31c449aeaad8c7759bc983ca0e26946e5b6746dc/drivers/soc/spacemit/v2d/v2d_reg.h#L170 has the related K1 formula with an additional core base.
